//ignore: custom-facets is the only example with a zintl package in `dependencies` rather than `devDependencies`, so it is the only one changesets treats as a releasable dependent. v2 never bumped it — it was absent from pre.json's initialVersions, which is what v2 built prereleases from. v3 dropped initialVersions and reads versions off disk, which made it eligible. It is a private example that is never published; ignoring it keeps examples at 0.0.0 the way every release so far has left them.
//privatePackages: changesets v3 (@changesets/config v4) flipped this default from true to false. @zintljs/testing is private, so the flip reclassified it as an *ignored* package, and the 17 changesets naming it alongside a published one became illegal "mixed" changesets. Setting it back keeps the pre-v3 behaviour the whole release history was built on: testing is versioned in lockstep with the packages it tests, and stays unpublished because it is private.
